 Advertisement Updated: 6:28 PM EST Nov 7, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caroline Castora Meteorologist Morning lows drop into the 60s on Sunday
 Updated: 6:28 PM EST Nov 7, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caroline Castora Meteorologist FORT MYERS, Fla. — A weak cold front is ushering in some slight changes to the forecast. Drier and cooler air is moving in.
 Your Gulf Coast Weather Most Accurate Forecast has low temperatures falling into the 60s almost everywhere by Sunday morning. For our northern locations and inland, expect temperatures to fall into the low 60s. Coastal spots will trend closer to 70 degrees under mostly clear skies.
 Advertisement Gulf Coast News Sunday lows Sunday afternoon will consist of near-normal temperatures. High temperatures should peak in the low-to-mid 80s. No rain is forecast through the beginning of the week.
 Looking ahead, a more robust cold front is expected to bring much cooler air to the Gulf Coast. As of right now, high temperatures are forecast to reach the 70s by Friday. Morning lows could drop into the 50s by the weekend.
 Gulf Coast News high temperature trend In the tropics, Invest 94L maintains its very low development odds.
